real-font-measurement-v1.contract: Measure with the same font family, weight, tracking and line-height used for rendering.

headline-fit-monotonic-v1.contract: For identical content and geometry, Large >= Default >= Small. A larger intent must never render smaller.

split-shared-headline-v1.contract: Both equal-status Split panels use one shared computed headline size; longer copy wraps naturally.

list-content-fit-v1.contract: Fit list content within the approved scale floor and preserve overflow/line warnings.

list-header-connected-placement-v1.contract: List starts from measured header bottom plus bounded offset; it is never independently vertically centred.

playmap-art-direction-v1.contract: Map Clean/Playful/Poster to deterministic hierarchy, composition and graphic behaviour per template.

real-font-measurement-v2.contract: FontFaceSet.load must succeed; same full typography specification and native width on visible and untransformed hidden DOM.

headline-fit-monotonic-v2.contract: One content/geometry fit capacity for all intents. Large >= Default >= Small. Constrained targets warn. Fixed typography across intents.

list-content-fit-v2.contract: All primary/secondary/third content measured. Shrink primary from 46 to 32px; metadata >=21 and third >=20. Infeasible rows warn, no truncation/omission advertised as success.

list-header-connected-placement-v2.contract: Rows begin after actual measured headline/subheading bottom plus the composition-owned gap.

list-composition-v2.contract: Resolve a List-specific registered composition from the shared recipe.

list-clean-composition-v2.contract: Paper editorial index, fine rules, restrained tabs.

list-playful-composition-v2.contract: Teal expressive header, structural route/rail, offset colourful blocks on paper.

list-poster-composition-v2.contract: Yellow count-led header, diagonal band, teal body, oversized numerals and two-column rhythm.
